name: Grand Class
verdict: Grand Class is the luxury car-rental brand of Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL (Madrid), whose sole shareholder is Upcycling Holding SL. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Getafe CF's announcement (14 August 2025) describes Grand Class as a luxury-vehicle rental company in Madrid with a three-season deal covering the back of the shorts. Its owner's sole shareholder, Upcycling Holding SL, is run by Pedro Miguel Lopez Rubio; no state or fund capital appears in the registry entries.
